podcast.title: Bronski Beat's Quick Signing (Early 1980s)
podcast.body: London Records signed Bronski Beat after the band had performed only nine gigs. This rapid acquisition indicates the immediate impact and distinctive appeal the synth rock trio had on the music industry in the early 1980s. "It took them all of nine gigs to get a record deal with London Records."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Early Days of LGBTQ Rock

podcast.title: Early Large Label
podcast.body: London Records is cited as one of the larger labels during a historical period when thousands of independent labels existed before industry consolidation. "They were some that were bigger than others like Deca and London and RCA and EMI, but there were literally thousands of small labels that did their own thing."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of Indie Rock: Part 1
